name: 0.security
long_description:
0.security is an applied AI research lab helping developers, AI-native startups, and enterprises to continuously find & fix security risks 24/7.

Our autonomous cybersecurity team has found & fixed previously unknown vulnerabilities in operating systems, government code and software powering more than 3 billion devices.

We work with EY, big pharma, financial services, AI-native startups and defense organisations to secure systems at the pace & depth needed to defend against AI-powered attackers.
